name: Toxic Deluge
clause: As an additional cost to cast ~, pay X life. / All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn.

needs.proposedSignature: AbilityCost.payLife: number | Amount   AND   AmountExpr.negate?: true (or `times: -1` over a base form meaning X)
needs.semantics: Two halves of the same card: an additional cost of 'pay X life' (X chosen on cast) and a pump magnitude of -X. `payLife` is a plain number today, and every Amount form clamps or has no way to express a negated X.
